label: CRTC1::MAML2

sections.text: CRTC1 encodes a coactivator of CREB-dependent transcription.
MAML2 encodes a transcriptional coactivator in Notch signaling.

The fusion links a CRTC CREB-binding region to the MAML2 activation domain, causing constitutive recruitment of CBP/p300 and abnormal CREB-dependent transcription. It is a recurrent driver of mucoepidermoid carcinoma.
CRTC1/3::MAML2-positive mucoepidermoid carcinomas formed a favorable-outcome subgroup in a retrospective salivary cohort; the fusion does not by itself assign histologic grade.
